shots.name: Shot 1 - Establish the comparison
shots.description: Fade up from near-black into aqueous chamber. Camera pushes slowly toward floating traditional softgel. Label: Traditional softgel.

shots.name: Shot 2 - Traditional release
shots.description: Shell softens and opens along natural seam. Release large amber drops with surface tension and mild coalescence.

shots.name: Shot 3 - Slow dispersion
shots.description: Large drops drifting past membrane with limited contact. Label: Large oil droplets.

shots.name: Shot 4 - Seamless system transition
shots.description: Camera pass through one large amber droplet as full-frame transition. Reveals SMEDS softgel with cyan-teal accent lighting.

shots.name: Shot 5 - SMEDS activation
shots.description: Label: SMEDS softgel. Shell ruptures with controlled vortex into spiral of progressively smaller droplets.

shots.name: Shot 6 - Rapid microdispersion
shots.description: Field of 300+ microdroplets disperses evenly across aqueous volume. Broad membrane contact with gentle light pulses. Label: Microscopic droplets.

shots.name: Shot 7 - Resolve and end card
shots.description: Droplets settle into balanced field. Simple scientific end card with disclaimer and required placeholders.

captions.text: Most omega-3s don't fully blend in the body.
Our new delivery system changes that.
Instead of large oil drops, it forms microscopic droplets,
making them far easier to absorb—even without a fatty meal.
